title: When I read the Bible, I often imagine standing nearby, watching quietly…
paragraphs: When I read the Bible, I often imagine standing nearby, watching quietly…

Hidden among the rocks.
Breathing carefully.
Rain blinding my vision.
The waters rise faster than reason can comprehend.
From my shelter, I see it — the Ark lifting higher as the world disappears beneath it.
Judgment… and salvation in one scene.
Thunder shakes the ground beneath me. Wind tears across the valley. The earth itself seems to surrender.
And yet — the Ark does not sink.
The same waters that overwhelm everything else… carry the promise upward.
I remain still, realizing something that echoes into my own life:

Sometimes what feels like devastation
is actually divine repositioning.

Sometimes the rising waters are not meant to drown you —
but to lift what God has sealed.
What has God carried me through that I once feared would end me?
💭 What has God carried you through?
